name: aria.dev/skills/usage-eval-metrics
description: Computes cost, token, latency, and error metrics over NormalizedUsageRecord data with grouping, period comparison, and anomaly detection.
triggers: Compute usage metrics grouped by provider and model
Compare this month's LLM usage to last month
Detect anomalies in our Bedrock usage
What is our cost per 1k tokens by tenant?
usage: Call compute_usage_metrics with records and optional group_by dimensions; compare_periods for trend deltas; detect_anomalies with optional threshold overrides.
